blocks.md: Administrative data from Statistics Denmark that follow every worker and every private-sector firm over time.

- The population of Danish workers matched to the universe of private-sector Danish firms.
- Firm-level imports and exports by product and by origin or destination country.

blocks.title: Beyond the lecture
blocks.md: The worker registers are commonly called IDA (Integrated Database for Labour Market Research). Access is through Statistics Denmark's research services.

| Good for | Weak for |
| --- | --- |
| Linking firm trade shocks to the wages and careers of specific workers | External validity: a small, open, high-wage economy |
| Firm-specific trade instruments (country × product shares) | Open access |
| Full population — no sampling error, no top coding | — |
